NEGROS POWER ADVISORY
MANUAL LOAD DROPPING (MLD) SCHEDULE 
November 27, 2026 (Friday)
Due to the alert levels declared by the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) today, Distribution Utilities (DUs) in the Visayas, including Negros Power, have been directed to implement possible power interruptions through Manual Load Dropping (MLD). 
As per NGCP, in their advisory today via https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1MnH8QmHpS/, 10 plants are on forced outage from November, 1 plant since October, 2 plants since September, 2 plants since August, 1 plant since June, 3 plants since 2025, 1 plant since 2024, 2 plants since 2023, and 1 plant since 2021, while 20 plants are running on derated capacities, for a total of 599.2MW unavailable to the grid.
Factor/s that contributed to the RED and YELLOW Alert declarations:
1. Unavailability of TVI 2 (Unplanned Outage) and de-rated capacity of TVI 1 
2. Unavailability of PCPC and KSPC Unit 2 (both on Planned Outage)
3. Limited power import from Mindanao grid 
At present, the following feeders are being considered for possible MLD implementation (refer to the photo provided). In the meantime, the following are the actual areas that are currently offline:
Burgos Feeder 5
Time Offline: 5:39 PM
Time Online: 6:32 PM
Affected areas: C.L. Montelibano Ave. Greensville 1, 2 & 3, The Palisades, Capitol Heights Subd. Phase 1, 2 & 4, portion of Brgy. Montevista, Jack and Jill School Homesite, portion of Homesite (7/11, Homesite Market) Circumferential Rd. (McDonald's East, East View, Starbucks East, Maranatha Baptist Church, Pet Life, Villa Fe, Akishola Village, Prk. Active, Prk. Progreso, Prk. Isla, Prk. Gugma, Sto Niño Village
The Shophouse Heritage Arcade, From BS Aquino-Narra to Cl Montelibano Ave crossing, Portion Kamunsil St., Portion Bugnay Rd.
portion of C.L. Montelibano up to Lazy Hound Cafe including Villa Ramos Subd., Hervias Village 2"
**
Reclamation Feeder 3 
Time Offline: 5:40 PM
Time Online: 6:32 PM
Affected areas: Araneta St. (Rodriguez Avenue – Magsaysay), The Visayan Daily Star, DYRL, Rosario St. (Yulo to San Juan), Yulo’s Park, San Juan Street (Rosario St. to San Sebastian), ETCS, Purok Mars
**
Sum-ag Feeder 2
Time Offline: 5:48 PM
Time Online: 6:37 PM
Affected areas: From Sum-ag Substation along Abuanan Road (Sum-ag) to portion of Bago, Brgy. Tabunan, Quiet Place Resort, Brgy. Dulao, Purok Paho, Purok Maria Elena, Negros Occidental District Jail
**
Asdes-Gonzaga Feeder 6
Time Offline: 5:48 PM
Time Online: 6:37 PM
Affected areas:  From AGF6 — Dona Juliana Heights Subd., Sharina Heights Subd., Las Palmas Subd., Jocson Subd., Portion Brgy. 26, Portion Brgy. 27, Portion Brgy. 28, Purok Jardine, Purok Malvar Cubay, Gonzaga St. (Gonzaga Substation – Lopez Jaena St.) 
**
Please be advised that the schedule, duration, and affected feeders may change at any time, depending on the actual condition of the power system and/or further directives from NGCP.
Negros Power continues to closely coordinate with NGCP and will provide updates as necessary.
To know which feeder you are connected, please refer to the link: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/18oNLoVaqA/
For the latest information and updates, please refer to the official posts of Negros Power on our Facebook page. We encourage the public to regularly check our official posts for any changes to the MLD schedule, affected feeders, and other related advisories.
We sincerely ask for your understanding, patience, and cooperation as these measures are being implemented to help maintain the stability of the power grid.
#NegrosPower #VisayasGrid #NGCP #AlertLevels #ManualLoadDrop
